data.name: Anguj
data.gender_notes: Anguj is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Anguj is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Angu', meaning 'strength'. This name is a symbol of courage and power, evoking images of a strong and resilient individual. Anguj is also associated with the idea of a garland, signifying the gathering and celebration of various virtues and strengths. The name Anguj carries the meaning “Garland of Strength” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Anguj usually hope their child will grow to embody garland of strength and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Anguj belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Garland of Strength.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Anguj total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
